title: ID0370140-DC/Si-D/AT- [cLymeL] HMI screen is not responding accurately
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The input is recognized in a different place than where you press on the touch, so the control is no longer possible, and thus also the charging
Root cause: Faulty HMI
Solution: HMI replacement with new one
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  No
Warranty Status:
05/28/2025

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0370140-DC/Si-D/AT- [cLymeL] HMI screen is not responding accurately CRM:00796000683
additional_info.body:
Hi
Johannes Dissauer,
Greetings of the Day
As mentioned in this ticket, the issue has recurred with the charger. Could you please confirm if rebooting the charger resolves the touch issue with the HMI? This might be occurring due to a delay in communication (possibly overflow) between the frontend and backend systems. We kindly request setting an overnight automatic reboot (at least every two days) and updating the DLogic controller of this charger to the latest version to resolve this.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
